Home › Services › Electronics install

Marine electronics installation: GPS, fishfinders, VHF, trolling motors, NMEA 2000

Buy the unit online or at the store; we send an installer who mounts it clean, runs the transducer right, networks it, and sets it up so it works the first time out.

What's included

  • Multifunction display and fishfinder mounting
  • Transducer selection advice and install (transom, in-hull, through-hull)
  • NMEA 2000 backbone and engine data
  • VHF with DSC and GPS connection, antenna
  • Trolling motor install with proper fusing and plug
  • Radar, autopilot, and stereo on request
  • Clean wiring, labeled, with drip loops
When

Before season, before a fishing trip, whenever the old unit dies.

Time on site

2 to 6 hours

What it usually costs here

$350 to $900 for a display and transducer; trolling motor installs $300 to $600 plus parts; networked helm projects quoted.

In Tampa Bay specifically

Flats and nearshore fishing out of Hudson, Tarpon Springs, and St. Pete drives most installs: side-imaging transducers and trolling motors with spot-lock.

Engines

YamahaMercurySuzuki

Questions we get

Can you connect my engine data to the display?

Yes on most engines made in the last 15 years, via NMEA 2000 or the manufacturer's gateway. You will see fuel flow, hours, and alarms on screen.

Garmin, Simrad, Lowrance, Humminbird, Raymarine?

All of them.
